fact: The state digital operator's page says its cybersecurity actions follow the national cybersecurity strategy (SNC2022); the page carries no date, so the year is inferred from its 2022 footer and no strategy period is stated.

The Direction générale du chiffre et de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DCSSI) is stated to co-organise the second cybersecurity providers forum and to set the course and norms for cybersecurity.
